title: Central Visayas kasambahays to get P500 monthly wage increase

blocks.text: MANILA – Domestic workers or “kasambahays” in Central Visayas will see their monthly minimum wage rise by PHP500 starting October, the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) said Monday. In a social media post, DOLE said Wage Order No. ROVII-DW-06 raises the minimum monthly wage of domestic workers in the region to PHP7,500 from the current PHP7,000. READ: P42 wage hike for Central Visayas workers The wage adjustment covers general house helpers, “yayas,” cooks, gardeners, laundry workers and other individuals who regularly perform household work on an occupational basis.
